idea.title: Competitor price tracker — I check 6 sites manually every week, need automation

plan.tagline: Automate weekly competitor price checks across 6 sites in 60 seconds.
plan.problem: Indie hackers and small businesses waste hours weekly manually checking competitor prices on 6 different sites, leading to lost productivity and delayed pricing adjustments.
plan.solution: CLI tool that scrapes 6 competitor sites weekly, stores price history in SQLite, generates reports, and sends alerts when prices change—fully automated with zero manual work.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, solo developers, and small e-commerce businesses (e.g., dropshippers, SaaS solopreneurs) who sell products online and need to track competitor pricing without hiring help.

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for tracking sites/products + add/list commands to manage competitors

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: generate CSV/JSON reports of price changes + --watch flag for real-time alerts

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: --demo mode with hardcoded data + --help docs + edge case handling (timeouts, malformed HTML)

plan.demo_script: Run `pricepulse --demo` to see a mock report of 3 competitors with prices changing over 2 weeks. No internet needed—uses hardcoded data to simulate a full week of tracking.
plan.phuket_angle: Thai small businesses (e.g., beachwear dropshippers) can track competitor prices on Shopee, Lazada, and local e-commerce sites to adjust pricing dynamically for Phuket tourist season demand spikes.
